content: Python stdlib double-fork daemonization (Stevens APUE 13.3 / Sander Marechal recipe): fork() and parent exits (os._exit avoids double atexit/buffer flush); child chdir('/'), setsid(), umask(0); second fork() with parent exit so the daemon is NOT a session leader and can never re-acquire a controlling terminal; flush sys.stdout/stderr then dup2 /dev/null (or log file) onto stdio fds; write pidfile. Session members receive SIGHUP on tty disconnect — the second fork plus setsid escapes that. Constraint: fork before spawning any threads (fork+threads risks malloc/lock deadlocks).
